headline: Week 13: McCalfinjury Drops a 170-Burger While Stroud Boys Find New Ways to Suck
subhead: A week of beatdowns, bench tragedies, and one matchup that somehow involved Davis Mills again.
matchOfTheWeek: Christian McCalfinjury hung 170.96 on The Good Ladds and made it look like a bye week. Jordan Love (25.76) and Zach Ertz dropping a 25.6 from the tight end position is the kind of variance that makes Mig stare at the ceiling at 2am — especially with GOAT Young casually banking 22.54 on his bench. Mig had Jaydon 3, Jayden 1, and Jayden 2 all suited up and STILL got Jayden Done.
powerRankingsShakeup: McCalfinjury kicks the door in as a legit contender, while Stroud Boys (89.74, league-low) are speedrunning their way to a top-3 pick. The Prodigal Son ain't walking through that door, bro.
mainRecap:
Let's start at the top, because Rub My Chubb's A.J. Brown went full Madden cheat code with 35.20 and BigD walked over T swift's Baddies like a Vegas bachelor party. Tnicolle, you can't win when Marcus FREAKING MARIOTA puts up 24.26 on your bench. That's not a lineup decision, that's a hate crime against yourself.

Nut Olave Your Face beat QAmon by 32 and somehow this is the saddest win of the week. Nick left 50.32 points on the bench — Adonai Mitchell (24.2) and Tyrod Taylor (21.28) watching Mustard and Big Cock Brock do all the work while two starters napped. You're 91% efficiency away from being unbeatable and 100% of the way to being your own worst enemy. Meanwhile QAmon's 96.68 was carried by absolutely no one — Turf Toe Joe couldn't outrun this loss, ShAmon-Ra was just Amon-Mid, and the Tiny-Handed Vampire stayed in the coffin. Kyle, your team name has more juice than your starters.

Browning Out smoked Egbukkake behind Jameson Williams (26.9), though Patrick somehow benched a 22.6 from Terry McLaurin — bro, that's your guy, what are we doing. Szara meanwhile rolled out Erick None, Insta Drop, and Poopoo Atwell and is shocked he scored 122. The Mascot can only carry so much.

McBridesStrangeWhiteHock survived OnlyFants by 7.28 thanks to a vintage Trey McBride 26.2 and CeeDee Lamb showing up. Cubby got 29.4 from Rashee Rice and still lost — that's gotta sting like a bad Tinder match.

And then there's Little Peckers vs Stroud Boys, the lowest-scoring game of the week, a 101-to-89 slap fight that Mahomes (29.44) personally dragged across the finish line. Bjewett, when Money Mill$ is your offensive identity, the season's already a wrap. Unc came through. He always does.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Coach of the Year
weeklyAwards.blurb: Won by 32 and still left 50.32 on the bench — Nick is the only man who can win a fight and lose a tooth doing it.

weeklyAwards.title: Why Did You Even Show Up Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: 89.74 points in a SuperFlex league is not a lineup, it's a cry for help.

weeklyAwards.title: Marcus Mariota Memorial Bench Trophy
weeklyAwards.blurb: Starting a QB who scored less than Mariota in 2025 is a felony in 49 states.

weeklyAwards.title: Beat the Brakes Off Em
weeklyAwards.blurb: 170.96 at 91% efficiency — Matt finally remembered he had a fantasy team and immediately ruined Mig's weekend.
